Hey there, I'm Luciano Oliva Bianco, but folks call me Lulox * 

## FIRST STEPS

At **two** years old I took my first steps\
and I'm not talking about walking.

To play games on **DOS**,\
I had to type in a word and hit ENTER\
That was it.\
But hey, it was something.

I've always been a curious **self-taught** kid,\
productive and proactive\
(most of the time)

Case in point:\
at 10 I built my first desktop PC,\
at 12 **my first websites** for my [**Neopets**](https://www.neopets.com).

---

All through grade school\
and my freshman year of high school,\
I was always near the top of the class\
(without studying much)

I'd rather teach myself other stuff,\
so high school took a back seat.

I watched a ton of movies and documentaries.\
I could see the Matrix.\
A bit of a psychedelic conspiracy nut\
With every kind of music playing.

---

All of that thanks to [**The Pirate Bay**](https://grokipedia.com/page/The_Pirate_Bay).\
Its forums talked about **torrents**,\
**P2P**, **open source**, the **freedom of knowledge**.

And all of that was [**Bitcoin**](https://bitcoin.org),\
money instead of information\
P2P, transparent, open source.

It blew my mind.

---

I did **Bitcoin mining**\
on my homebuilt PC back in **2009** or **2010**, I can't even remember,

I ended up with a few tokens...\
But **I couldn't find a way to cash them out to pesos**!

Being a rookie\
at handling money,\
I stored the seed phrase\
without much care...

Well, that's gone for good,\
but it taught me one big lesson:\
**in the long run, Bitcoin goes up,\
and the dollar goes down, in purchasing power.**

**I celebrated** when we broke through\
**1 bitcoin, 1 dollar**.\
\
**I got bummed out** when we broke below\
**1 satoshi, 1 peso**.

## THE COLLEGE EXPERIENCE

**I tried** to make it through several universities.

I gave **Law**, **Image and Sound** and **Computer Science** a shot.\
The only thing that changed was how they bored me.

---

In **2015** I started working at [**FEDUN**](https://fedun.com.ar),\
a **federation of university faculty**.

Part of my job was **filming**\
classes and workshops by international guests\
talking about the latest in **education**,\
**technology**, and **audiovisual production**.

Getting to chat one-on-one\
with professors and deans\
was something I really loved.

It was finally the college experience I'd been looking for.\
I felt more at home with them than with the students.

---

Later on, around **2018**,\
they talked me into studying film at [**UNA Audiovisuales**](https://audiovisuales.una.edu.ar).\
And I gave it a fair shake.

I was passionate about\
storytelling and aesthetics,\
the symbolic and the spiritual,\
creating dreams you could play back again and again.

I wanted my first feature to be a cult classic,\
though maybe not **The Room** kind of cult.

## UNEARNED SUCCESS

In **2020**, with the pandemic,\
**remote learning** **just wasn't for me**.

I went all in on **trading,**\
**development** and **blockchain**.

"Trading" went great for me in **2021**,\
the market rewarded bad decisions,\
and I'd become an expert at making them.

Case in point:\
after I lost 85% of my capital in a single month,\
I bought **NFTs** from [**Axie Infinity**](https://axieinfinity.com) and **ICE Poker**,\
which would go on to lose\
over 90% of their value too.

You live and learn.

## BLOCKCHAIN FOR REAL

In **2022** I was one of the first\
to use [**ChatGPT**](https://chatgpt.com) when it went public,\
since I already had a beta account\
from trying out [**DALL-E**](https://openai.com/index/dall-e-3/)\
to generate images.

I felt my ability\
to develop ideas and concepts\
kick into high gear, on the spot.

Once again I felt that inexplicable thing\
I'd felt when I first found Bitcoin.

There it was, the future of technology.\
Again.

---

In **2023** I had another huge formative experience,\
courtesy of [**BuidlGuidl**](https://app.buidlguidl.com/builders/0xfBD9Ca40386A8C632cf0529bbb16b4BEdB59a0A0),\
the [**Ethereum Foundation**](https://ethereum.foundation)'s builder **DAO**.

With them I learned a whole lot\
about blockchain, smart contracts,\
and building dApps, websites that talk to them.

And on top of that, I got paid to learn!\
Ah, those were the days.

---

In **2024** that chapter closed.\
I started entering hackathons,\
and won a few.

I also started hitting coworking spaces\
to see what other folks were up to\
at startups\
riding the crest of the wave.

[**Crecimiento**](https://crecimiento.build) ("growth" in Spanish) made me grow,\
both professionally\
and as a person.

There I learned about startups,\
got to know the local ecosystem\
and people from all over the world.

I enjoyed every single day there,\
I even went into debt\
living on cheap food\
just to spend more time there

**Concepción Live** was a beautiful place.\
If you were there, you know what I'm talking about.

## AGENTS AND RESEARCH

In **2025** I started working\
at [**Input Output Group**](https://iohk.io),\
which had just opened offices\
in **Torre Catalinas Plaza**.

Being new in town, they needed talent\
to help them hit their goals in the country.

I went to an asado with the team,\
then I checked out the offices, they put me to the test,\
and before long I was spending my days with them.

There I also got to know\
more of the local ecosystem\
and people from all over the world.

I started out building **automations** with [**n8n**](https://n8n.io)\
and a web app to round out\
the team's workflow with online tools,

Whenever they asked me to research something,\
I felt it pulled me away from my main role.

---

Then the shift got impossible to miss,\
**AI agents made everything easier**,\
building and automating included.

Automations that used to take days\
now took hours, tops.

But my role wasn't just development,\
it was development and **research**

I'm grateful I picked up\
solid **methodology** and **judgment**.

That led me to recently co-author,\
alongside well-known professionals\
and English-speaking professors,\
papers analyzing:

- [The current landscape of tokenization.](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7501713293321854976/)
- [The legal context of agentic commerce](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Malx_E4Z1flmVr5hQgCRejJEWL8HxjiQ/view?usp=drive_link).

## TODAY

I live in **La Boca**, Buenos Aires.

I like a good **coffee**,\
a good **smoke**,\
and a **good** conversation.

If you're more of a **cat** person\
than a dog person,\
we've got something in common.

And if not, maybe we still do.
